# Callpage

CallPage is a lead capture tool that enables businesses to connect with website visitors through immediate phone callbacks, enhancing lead generation and sales conversion rates.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/callpage/.

## Actions

- **Get All Managers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of managers for a specific widget with pagination.
- **Get All SMS Messages** (read-only): Retrieve all sms messages for a widget.
- **Get All Users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all users with pagination.
- **Get All Widgets** (read-only): Retrieve a list of widgets with pagination.
- **Get API Root** (read-only): Get the root api greeting.
- **Get SMS Statistics** (read-only): Retrieve statistical data about sms messages.
- **Get Widget** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific widget by id.
- **Create Voice Message**: Create a custom voice message for a widget.
- **Create Widget**: Create a new widget.
- **Delete Widget by Id**: Delete a widget by id.
- **Get Manager Status Statistics**: Retrieve statistical data about manager statuses.
- **Get Widget Status Statistics**: Retrieve statistical data about widget statuses.
- **Reset SMS**: Reset sms messages to default for a widget.
- **Reset Voice Messages**: Reset voice messages to default for a widget.
- **Update Manager**: Update an existing manager.
- **Update Widget**: Update an existing widget.
- **Widget Call or Schedule**: Initiate or schedule a call via widget.
